upstream_report.scope: Ascend 950DT GroupedGemmFwdOp: all six manifest calls, seven dtype cases (moe-fwd NT bfloat16 and float16, moe-dgrad NN float16, moe-wgrad TN float16, three qwen3-30b-ep8 NT bfloat16 routes). The schedules are generalized from DeepGEMM's m-grouped and k-grouped kernels; not a public performance receipt.

campaign.metric: arithmetic mean of raw ffts device execution interval unions
campaign.reason: Task-private protocol adapter: one profiler window carries all 25 calls instead of one window per call. The eviction and the parsed statistic are unchanged; the public default-clock receipt and the host-wide reservation are still unavailable.
campaign.workspace: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

environment.canonical_profile_note: The maintained profile pins the runtime/OPP to CANN 9.1.0 and the compiler and headers to the 9.2.0 release. This container serves 9.2.0 for every component; that deviation is recorded here instead of being rounded into one version string.

baseline_environment.note: DeepGEMM's extension is ABI-locked to the PyTorch 2.7 stack, so the DeepGEMM arm runs in a second process on the same device in the same round.

campaign.float16_baseline: DeepGEMM BF16 arm on the same shape and round; DeepGEMM has no float16 grouped entry point and the matrix unit runs both 16-bit dtypes at the same rate.
campaign.deepgemm_scope: DeepGEMM's m-grouped kernels require group starts on a 256-row boundary and its k-grouped entry point takes the group sizes on the host, so only the three moe-* cases have a DeepGEMM baseline.
